evidence.quote: PBMCs were cryopreserved or lysed and stored at -80C for subsequent RNA extraction using miRNeasy (Qiagen) and hybridization to HG 1.0 ST arrays (Affymetrix).

flow cytometry assay.readouts: cell population frequencies expressed as percent of parent population

evidence.quote: Frozen PBMCs from all time points for a subject were stained for 5 panels (Figure S1A) ( Biancotto et al., 2011 ) using a common antibody mix on the same day.

serum neutralization of viral infectivit.readouts: highest serum dilution that completely suppressed virus replication

evidence.quote: Virus-neutralizing titers (A/California/07/2009 (H1N1pdm09), H1N1 A/Brisbane/59/07, H3N2 A/Uruguay/716/07, and B/Brisbane/60/2001) were determined according to ( Hancock et al., 2009 ).

enzyme-linked immunospot assay.readouts: total and influenza-specific IgG/A frequencies of antibody-secreting cells

evidence.quote: Total and influenza-specific IgG/A frequencies of antibody-secreting cells were measured by ELISpot assays modified for frozen samples ( Ho et al., 2011 ).
